Describe the behavior change and its validation.

For styling changes:

- [ ] Use shared semantic tokens where a matching role exists; explain intentional local values.
- [ ] Run `cedarcli check design-tokens --strict` and prune resolved baseline findings.
- [ ] Check affected focus, error, read-only and narrow-host states; preserve host overrides.

[Token usage and exceptions](https://github.com/metadatacenter/cedar-design-tokens/blob/develop/README.md#monitor-adoption)
